lines.text: A modest house can make the cut.
A listing waits to be found.
It was never a matter of price.

notes: [How to read it] Point Direction | Tone Dry and level, with the wit left in the words. Underplay every line; no wink. | Sync "editors" should land as the frame squares up at 0:11.5, and "never" at about 0:25.4 as the word drops into the line on screen. | Silence Florida plays with no voice, and there is a beat before each second sentence. | Last line It is the name, so read it plainly as the wordmark settles.

[Swaps] Swap Replaces line Current wording Alternative | Opening, more explicit 1 and 2 Every home has a price. It's rarely the interesting part. A listing tells you what a home costs. It rarely tells you what it is. | Markets, warmer 8 Even our map is edited. Three markets. We'd rather know a place than cover it. | Current wording is read from the Script tab, so it follows any edit made there.

[To confirm] Stance Line As written | Editors, not brokers 5 We're not brokers. We're editors. | A listing waits 6 A listing waits to be found. | The map is edited 8 Even our map is edited. | These three stances are wording drawn from the brief rather than quoted from it: check you are happy saying them out loud. | Nothing in the script claims a result or a number.
